title: Передаём вчерашнее сообщение
description: Передаём вчерашнее сообщение: применяем правило в самостоятельных ситуациях, работаем со словарём и читаем авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Передавать прошлое сообщение через said that
notes: При пересказе прошлого сообщения часто используется сдвиг am → was: She said that she was tired.
Tell требует адресата: He told me ...; say не получает me без to: He said to me ...

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: Yesterday, Sara said, “I am tired.” При пересказе со сдвигом времени: Sara said that she ___ tired.
exercises.explanation: Для she и сдвига am в прошлое используется was.

exercises.prompt: Дополни предложение словом из пары: said / told.

public_payload.sentence: He ___ me that the room was available.

exercises.editorial_answer: He told me that the room was available.
exercises.explanation: Перед me без to нужен told.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Она сказала нам, что встреча отменена.»
exercises.editorial_answer: She told us that the meeting was cancelled.
exercises.explanation: Told принимает адресата us; сообщение передаётся через that.

exercises.prompt: Исправь указанную конструкцию, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The organiser said me that the room was closed.

accepted: The organiser told me that the room was closed.

exercises.reference_answer: The organiser told me that the room was closed.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The organiser said me that the room was closed.
exercises.editorial_answer: The organiser told me that the room was closed.
exercises.explanation: В задании сохраняем me без предлога и заменяем said на told.

exercises.prompt: Почему Сара не пришла на встречу?

public_payload.passage: On Monday, I asked Sara whether she could join our planning meeting that afternoon. She said that she was tired after travelling and wanted to rest. I told the organiser that Sara would not attend. The next morning, Sara emailed a written suggestion, so the group could still consider her idea even though she had missed the discussion.

options.label: She had no ideas about the project.
She was tired after travelling and wanted to rest.
The organiser had refused to invite her.

exercises.editorial_answer: She was tired after travelling and wanted to rest.
exercises.explanation: Её причина передана через said that; отказа в приглашении нет.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова урока с переводом в указанном контексте.
exercises.editorial_answer: message — сообщение; explain — объяснять; confirm — подтверждать; available — свободный, доступный
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: message — сообщение; explain — объяснять; confirm — подтверждать; available — свободный, доступный.

exercises.prompt: Как её идея попала в обсуждение группы?

public_payload.passage: On Monday, I asked Sara whether she could join our planning meeting that afternoon. She said that she was tired after travelling and wanted to rest. I told the organiser that Sara would not attend. The next morning, Sara emailed a written suggestion, so the group could still consider her idea even though she had missed the discussion.

options.label: She sent a written suggestion the next morning.
She attended the entire Monday meeting.
The organiser invented a suggestion in her name.

exercises.editorial_answer: She sent a written suggestion the next morning.
exercises.explanation: Сара отправила письменное предложение уже после пропущенной встречи.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: How can I report his message without changing “me” to “to me”?

options.label: He told that me the train delayed.
He told me that the train was delayed.
He said me that the train was delayed.

exercises.editorial_answer: He told me that the train was delayed.
exercises.explanation: Told me — нужная модель; said потребовало бы to me.

public_payload.sentence: To make an arrangement definite is to ___ it.

exercises.explanation: Confirm — подтвердить, а не отменить или забыть.
